user.title: Solar and home battery
user.description: Map the Sol-Ark readings. Nothing is commanded until shadow mode is turned off: the planner starts in shadow mode, planning and explaining without calling any service.

data_description.pv_power_unit: Used when the sensor states no unit; a sensor's own W or kW always wins.
data_description.pv_power_invert: Turn on if the sensor reports production as negative.
data_description.grid_power: Grid power, for example sensor.sol_ark_inverter_grid_power. The planner needs import positive and export negative.
data_description.grid_power_unit: Used when the sensor states no unit.
data_description.grid_power_invert: Turn on if the sensor reports export as positive.
data_description.battery_power: Home battery power, for example sensor.sol_ark_inverter_battery_power. The planner needs charging positive.
data_description.battery_power_unit: Used when the sensor states no unit.
data_description.battery_power_invert: Turn on if the sensor reports discharging as positive.
data_description.battery_soc: Home battery level in %, for example sensor.sol_ark_inverter_battery_state_of_charge.
data_description.battery_capacity: Optional. Usable capacity in kWh, for example sensor.sol_ark_battery_capacity_estimate. Without it, the fixed capacity below is used.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable capacity when no capacity sensor is mapped or it is unavailable.
data_description.battery_max_charge_kw: AC-side limit of the inverter's battery charging.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_kw: AC-side limit of the inverter's battery discharging.
data_description.battery_reserve_pct: The level at which the inverter stops discharging.

charger.title: Wall Connector
charger.description: The Wall Connector is read only: it reports the car's power and whether a vehicle is connected.

data_description.wall_power: The car's charging power, for example sensor.tesla_wall_connector_total_power. House use is solar + grid - battery - this.
data_description.wall_power_unit: Used when the sensor states no unit.
data_description.wall_current: Optional. Shown with each change, to confirm the car followed it.
data_description.wall_connected: Recommended. On while a vehicle is connected. Off means no car is on the charger, so no car is commanded. It does not say which car is connected.
data_description.charger_max_a: The Wall Connector's current setting (it cannot be changed through Home Assistant).
data_description.volts: Used to turn currents into power.

tariff.title: Forecast and free hours
tariff.description: Prices and the other settings are entities of the planner. Add the cars and any extra price levels afterwards, from the planner's entry.

data_description.forecast_today: The sensor with today's detailedForecast attribute (half hours with pv_estimate10, pv_estimate and pv_estimate90), for example sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_today.
data_description.forecast_tomorrow: The same for tomorrow, for example sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_tomorrow.
data_description.forecast_last_polled: Optional. When Solcast was last polled; an old forecast widens the planner's uncertainty.
data_description.free_hours: Optional. A Schedule helper that is on while import is free. Repaint it when the plan changes. Leave it empty for a flat or time-of-use plan; add other price levels as price windows.

error.same_forecast: Today's and tomorrow's forecast must be different sensors.

abort.already_configured: The planner is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: The planner is already set up.

user.title: Add a car
user.description: Choose the kind of car. Only one car can be on the Wall Connector at a time; the planner commands only the car it sees on it.

car.title: Car entities
car.description: Map the {kind} car's entities. Each Tesla command is billed by Tesla's API; each Rivian change is a charging-schedule write through Rivian schedule control.

data_description.name: Used for the car's device and entity IDs, for example R1S or Roxxo.
data_description.switch: Tesla: the Tesla Fleet charge switch (switch.roxxo_charge). Rivian: Rivian schedule control's Solar charging switch (switch.r1s_schedule_control_solar_charging).
data_description.current: Tesla: the Tesla Fleet charge current (number.roxxo_charge_current). Rivian: Rivian schedule control's Solar current (number.r1s_schedule_control_solar_current).
data_description.limit: The car's own charge limit in %.
data_description.plugged: On while this car's cable is connected (any charger). The planner commands a car only while it is plugged in, at home, and the Wall Connector does not report no vehicle.
data_description.location: Recommended. The car's own device tracker (home), not a person, or a binary sensor that is on at home.
data_description.control_state: Optional, recommended for a Rivian: sensor.r1s_schedule_control_control_state. Its attributes tell a pause from no request, so a request that Rivian schedule control dropped is sent again.
data_description.max_a: 48 A for both on a 48 A Wall Connector. The current number's own maximum also applies.
data_description.capacity_kwh: Usable battery energy, used to turn levels into kWh.

user.title: Price window
user.description: A price level painted on a Schedule helper. The free hours come first, then the price windows in the order they were added; outside all of them the planner's import price applies.

data_description.schedule: A Schedule helper that is on while this price applies, for example a peak period.
data_description.label: Shown in the price entity's name, for example Peak.
data_description.price: Per kWh while the schedule is on. It can be changed later from the planner's price entity.
data_description.export_price: Optional. What exported solar earns while the schedule is on; otherwise the solar buyback.
